name: Kangaroo Beach
description: Welcome to Kangaroo Beach, a sun-soaked seaside paradise, populated by a kooky cast of colourful animals. This seemingly idyllic haven is never far from peril, but beachgoers are safe, thanks to the courageous lifesavers on patrol.

videos.title: Summer Special
videos.overview: The cadets become stranded on a deserted beach and all seems lost. But Neville recalls another time they almost gave up, and we flashback to the first day of summer at Kangaroo Beach.

videos.title: Family Day Special
videos.overview: It's Family Day and the young animal cadets are excited to welcome their parents for a day of fun-filled seaside activities on Kangaroo Beach.

videos.title: Mountain Mystery Special
videos.overview: The cadets head into the mountains for a daring rescue mission to save rescue dummy Dotty, but along the way, they make a surprising new friend and stumble upon a hunt for pirate treasure!

videos.title: Pounce On Patrol
videos.overview: Wearing Bondi's cap, Pounce thinks he's chief lifeguard - but when Gemma and Neville need rescuing from a whale encounter, should he jump in, or alert a real lifeguard?

videos.title: The Beach Race
videos.overview: The cadets are competing in an epic beach race and Gemma is determined to beat Pounce to the finish - until an emergency breaks out in the last leg.

videos.title: Neville's Shark Drone
videos.overview: When Neville builds a drone to help make sure local great white shark Charlene doesn't come too close to the beach, it proves to be better than the lifeguards... almost.

videos.title: Rescue Roo
videos.overview: When Pounce sprains his thumper in the sand dunes, he's devastated to miss out on an exciting Rescue Day - but discovers that not every rescue is action-packed.

videos.title: Lighthouse Storm
videos.overview: Frizzy leads Bondi and the cadets on a dangerous journey into the hills to replace the lighthouse bulb during a storm.

videos.title: Frizzy's Big Show!
videos.overview: When a TV crew shows up to film real life rescues on Kangaroo Beach, Frizzy vows to become world famous by being rescued.

videos.title: The Trophy Mystery
videos.overview: The cadets are tasked with babysitting toddler penguin Phillipa, but become distracted when a cheeky crab scurries off with a lifeguard trophy.

videos.title: Island Rescue
videos.overview: The cadets become stranded on Boomerang Island, but Neville vows to save the day with his backpack of supplies and emergency underpants.

videos.title: Ready Cadet Go!
videos.overview: The cadets compete in a series of lifeguard challenges, but Frizzy is distracted by the promise of shiny gold medals.

videos.title: The Big Swim
videos.overview: The cadets help Neville overcome a bad case of the wobblies before competing in the Battle of the Boards swimming challenge.

videos.title: King Tide's Castle
videos.overview: Neville pretends to be royalty and builds himself a life-size sandcastle, but forgets Kangaroo Beach is due for a king tide.

videos.title: Wild Waterslide
videos.overview: A giant inflatable waterslide is erected on the lagoon, but before they can ride, the cadets must teach the younger kids how to float. When the waterslide blows out to sea, Wei's brand new floating skills come in handy.

videos.title: Stay Calm & Snorkel
videos.overview: Gemma can't wait to explore on Snorkelling Day, but her snorkel gets in the way. Frizzy is being distracting while the cadets learn how to stay calm in the water, but in the end, it's Frizzy who teaches Gemma how to relax.

videos.title: Dream Team
videos.overview: Pounce, Frizzy and Gemma each have their own personal superstar lifeguard hero. But during an action-packed ride-along day, they discover that it's not about the individual, but the team.

videos.title: Coach Koala
videos.overview: Big Trev is worried about passing his annual lifeguard fitness test, so Frizzy offers to help with an early morning boot camp.

videos.title: The Shark Prank
videos.overview: When Reef and Roadie are rejected from the cadets' safety film, they disrupt the production with a set of pranks, but end up learning a valuable lesson about pretending to be in trouble when you're not.

videos.title: Heatwave
videos.overview: It's the hottest day of summer and while Gemma leads a dolphin rescue, Pounce is determined to prove kangaroos can beat the heat.

videos.title: Cadets vs Champs
videos.overview: It's Carnival Day at Kangaroo Beach, with two teams competing in lifeguard games. But it's the young cadets versus the lifeguards - how can they possibly win against a stellar team of grown-up champions?

videos.title: Trash Pets
videos.overview: When the cadets create animals out of rubbish they've cleaned from the beach, they dub them 'trash pets' and inspire other beachgoers to make their own, but things get out of hand and their treasure becomes trash once more.

videos.title: The Lagoon Monster
videos.overview: When Pounce falls in the lagoon and gets covered in seaweed, the other cadets mistake him for a swamp monster, and decide they have to capture it.

videos.title: Turtle Toddlers
videos.overview: It's the day of the big Kangaroo Beach beach cricket match, but when Gemma and the cadets find a nest of turtle eggs, they play 'parents', vowing to protect the eggs from seagulls, crabs and flying cricket balls.

videos.title: Cadets In Charge
videos.overview: When the cadets are put in charge of running the lifeguard club all by themselves, it proves to be the toughest - and most rewarding - day of their lives.

videos.title: Frizzy's Treasure Hunt
videos.overview: While scuba diving over the reef, Frizzy swims off from her buddy Big Trev in search of hidden treasure and becomes lost underwater.

videos.title: Island Campout
videos.overview: Camping out overnight on Boomerang Island with the cadets, Frizzy goes on a late night hunt for an alien koala.

videos.title: Sandy's Surf School
videos.overview: When Neville fails to learn how to surf as well as his friends, he builds a self-surfing surfboard - but it quickly lands him in hot water.

videos.title: Brave in the Waves
videos.overview: When Pounce pretends he's an expert at diving under big waves, his friends ask him to teach them how - and he soon finds himself in deep trouble.

videos.title: Hoppy Christmas
videos.overview: The cadets prepare for another exciting Christmas at Kangaroo Beach, but a homesick Gherkinn misses the winter Christmas' he is used to, which just will not do!

videos.title: Wallaby Waters
videos.overview: A celebrity quokka visits Kangaroo Beach to film an episode of the smash hit TV series Wallaby Waters.

videos.title: Shipwrecked
videos.overview: Frizzy and Gemma investigate the mysterious disappearance of several boats in Kangaroo Beach's 'Barramundi Triangle'.

videos.title: Captain Frizzy
videos.overview: Frizzy sets sail around Boomerang Island in an effort to break Big Trev's record.

videos.title: Junior Junior Cadets
videos.overview: The cadets attempt to train four young kids as 'Junior Junior Cadets' - but their first lesson is a disaster!

videos.title: Philippa's Pool Party
videos.overview: The cadets are planning an epic surprise pool party for Phillipa's birthday but when things get out of hand, they forget the golden pool rule: keep the gate shut.

videos.title: The Grand Crabby Hotel
videos.overview: The cadets build the Grand Crabby Hotel to protect rock pool sea creatures from the seagulls, but soon learn that despite being tough they shouldn't be moved.

videos.title: King Kanga
videos.overview: Kangaroo Beach legend, King Kanga, is back and ready to rule the beach. But the cadets soon learn that he has a very different lifeguarding approach.

videos.title: Gemma's Whale Rescue
videos.overview: Gemma's obsession with a pair of passing whales distracts her from her duties. Meanwhile, one of the whales does some 'wombat watching' and becomes beached.

videos.title: Bondi vs Sandy
videos.overview: The cadets train Bondi and Sandy for their annual Iron Roo carnival - but how far are they willing to go to win?

videos.title: Really Real Rescues
videos.overview: Really Real Rescues visits Kangaroo Beach to film a TV special about the cadets, but trying to look cool on camera lands them in hot water.

videos.title: Night Dive
videos.overview: Worried about scuba diving for the first time, Neville runs off in the middle of the night.

videos.title: Doctor Wombat
videos.overview: When multiple emergencies break out on a windy day at Kangaroo Beach, Neville offer help as an assistant medic. Meanwhile, Pounce learns how to kite surf.

videos.title: Master of the Waves
videos.overview: Four young animal friends spend an action-packed summer at the spectacular Kangaroo Beach, training as junior cadets with their lifeguard heroes. When an emergency breaks out, the cadets step up to help keep the water safe.

videos.title: Super Roo
videos.overview: Four young animal friends spend an action-packed summer at the spectacular Kangaroo Beach, training as junior cadets with their lifeguard heroes. When an emergency breaks out, the cadets step up to help keep the water safe.

videos.title: Surf Club Sleepover
videos.overview: Four young animal friends spend an action-packed summer at the spectacular Kangaroo Beach, training as junior cadets with their lifeguard heroes. When an emergency breaks out, the cadets step up to help keep the water safe.

videos.title: Girl Who Cried Jellyfish
videos.overview: Frizzy gets herself in trouble when she cries 'shark'. Then when she spots real danger headed for Kangaroo Beach, no one believes her.

videos.title: Canoe Adventure
videos.overview: The cadets hit the river with their canoes for a picnic day. But while Frizzy and Gemma cannot paddle in sync, Neville and Pounce find themselves in hot water.

videos.title: The Cave
videos.overview: Pounce leads an adventure into a cave, but the cadets become trapped by the rising tide. Meanwhile, Frizzy goes in search of a volcano.

videos.title: Splashdance
videos.overview: Gemma is inspired by Wanda and Big Trev's synchronised swimming routines and pushes herself to learn it.

videos.title: Neville and the Mermaid
videos.overview: When Neville thinks he sees a mermaid in the lagoon, he sets out to find her.

videos.title: The Fun Float
videos.overview: Things get out of hand when Neville's plan for a peaceful day of floating on the river turns into a wild race.

videos.title: Jumping Joey
videos.overview: When Pounce competes against Reef & Roadie in a jumping contest, his friends worry he's putting himself in danger.

videos.title: Jurassic Beach
videos.overview: Gemma tries to impress her zoologist hero when dinosaur bones are discovered on Kangaroo Beach. But what sort of dinosaur do they belong to?

videos.title: Spyke The Cadet
videos.overview: It's Spyke's first day of training with the cadets on Kangaroo Beach and she's so excited to jump into all the action that she forgets to pay attention in class - learning the hard way that safety always comes first!

videos.title: Meet The Gherkinns
videos.overview: Gherkinn's family visits Kangaroo Beach, eager to see their heroic lifeguard son in action! But when they arrive, they discover Ghërkinn hasn't been entirely truthful with them...

videos.title: Robo Dotty
videos.overview: Neville convinces the lifeguards to purchase a new Robo-Dummy 3000, which they lovingly name 'Robo-Dotty'. But when 'Robo-Dotty' goes rogue, enforcing extreme rules, it's up to the cadets to get things back under control.

videos.title: The Big Mum Swim
videos.overview: Inspired by Gemma and her mum smashing their personal best in the ocean, Neville takes on a challenge of his own - teaching his mum, Narelle, how to swim!

videos.title: Ooky Spooky Story
videos.overview: On a moonlit campout by the lake, the cadets challenge each other to see who can tell the ookiest, spookiest story.

videos.title: Charlene's Dream
videos.overview: Gemma talks Big Trev into letting the cadets stay overnight in the submarine for the annual coral spawning, but their dreamy adventure gets derailed when they nearly crash into a sleep-swimming Charlene!

videos.title: Big Baby Cadet Challenge
videos.overview: The cadets create a fun obstacle course for the Junior Junior Cadets, but when Reef and Roadie discover there's a prize at stake, they hilariously disguise themselves as babies to steal the spotlight!

videos.title: Monster Toad
videos.overview: A day at the lake turns into chaos when Frizzy and Spyke become convinced there's a monster toad prowling the lake, the Cadets must uncover the truth behind the mysterious phantom frog.

videos.title: Buddy Day
videos.overview: The cadets pair up with a Junior Junior Cadet to show the importance of always swimming with a buddy, but Frizzy gets carried away with the theatrics of it all and forgets what it takes to be a good buddy.

videos.title: Koala Kraken
videos.overview: While Gemma tests out her new underwater camera, Frizzy and Pounce dive headfirst into an investigation of a mysterious sea monster sighting!

videos.title: Dive Quest
videos.overview: The cadets buddy up for their first underwater orienteering adventure, ticking off sea creatures in an epic game of ocean bingo along the way.

videos.title: Dad Rescue
videos.overview: When Frizzy's dad gets into trouble in the mountains, Frizzy steps up to lead the rescue mission and save the day!

videos.title: Little Trev's Turtle
videos.overview: Big Trev tells Pounce and Gemma a tale from his childhood as they wait for his elderly turtle friend, Salty, to arrive.

videos.title: Castaway Cadets
videos.overview: On a paddle board expedition, the cadets get 'stranded' on a desert island. Meanwhile, Neville goes on a journey to become the ultimate balance master.

videos.title: Spyke's Splash Bash
videos.overview: When Spyke introduces Neville to his alter ego Daredevil Neville, her fun-filled Splash Bash take a dangerous turn.

videos.title: Snap
videos.overview: Mysterious moving objects and strange sand patterns have Frizzy convinced that Alien Koalas are invading Kangaroo Beach! But Gemma uncovers a much crabbier culprit!

videos.title: The Curse of Boomerang Island
videos.overview: What starts as a leisurely sailing trip for Frizzy, Spyke, Big Trev, and Aunty Bev takes a dangerous turn when their boat gets caught on the reef, and they find themselves racing against time!

videos.title: Whale Song Spectacular
videos.overview: Gemma dreams of seeing a baby whale and the cadets help her throw a whale concert to attract their attention.

videos.title: Beach N Bush
videos.overview: In an attempt to prove which is best - the beach or the bush - Gemma and Spyke take the Junior Junior Cadets on a fun day of adventure that almost ends in disaster.

videos.title: Hungry The Seagull
videos.overview: Spyke befriends a seagull named Hungry, but things get out of hand when his flock begin disrupting things on Kangaroo Beach.

videos.title: The Snack Shack Comeback
videos.overview: When Ferdinand's beloved Snack Shack is damaged in a storm, Neville organises a fundraiser to buy him a new one.

videos.title: The Everything Day
videos.overview: When Pounce's dad Hoppa visits Kangaroo Beach for the day, Pounce tries to cram everything into one day and forgets to heed basic safety principles.

videos.title: Landcastle
videos.overview: On Spyke's last day at Kangaroo Beach, the cadets build an epic landcastle by the lake to give her a send-off she'll never forget.

videos.title: The Bestest Beach
videos.overview: The cadets pull out all the stops to impress a beach inspector and win the prestigious Bestest Beach Award, all in honour of their dedicated lifeguard heroes.
